name: ProcessingInstruction
title: ProcessingInstruction — nodeType 7
description: XML serialization node; text/html does not serialize processing-instruction nodes. DOM APIs can create ProcessingInstruction objects even for an HTML document, so XML-only describes syntax use, not all possible API-created objects.

serialization.text_html: Serialized as <?target data>. The text/html parser never produces one: <?...?> is parsed as a bogus Comment. The DOM API can still create one in an HTML document.

notes.note: The HTML parser turns <?...> into a Comment; the DOM API can still create one in an HTML document.
